semantic.justification: Generic native parser and exact two-half segment algorithm with ERROR/RETAIN/REMOVE parent policies, additional-special-segment flag, absolute/relative/empty URI branches and query/fragment precedence. No browser URL normalization, escape decoding or excess-parent removal is substituted. Specialized scheme component service lookup, makeRelative and UNO service registration are omitted. Whole-module parity stays unverified and DOCX application/UI import/export is not yet established.
